title: Encode launch attachment filenames for headers

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-323#encode-launch-attachment-filenames-for-headers

**Outcome: Caught.** The maintained Headers-safety assertion detects omission of percent-encoding for a non-Latin-1 attachment filename.

Story and checked revision: `.planning/seeds/SEED-323-launch-attachment-non-latin1-filenames.md#encode-launch-attachment-filenames-for-headers` at `a58fe69dc24481f4e57459bf08c441a0dffd09e0`. The selected promise is that a non-Latin-1 `File.name` yields a Headers-safe `x-launch-attachment-name` value that recovers for sanitize.

Fault: in `dashboard/src/launchAttachments.ts` `launchAttachmentNameHeaderValue`, replace `return encodeURIComponent(name)` with `return name`.

Maintained proof: `dashboard/backend-tests/launches/launch-attachment-refusals.spec.ts`, test “a non-Latin-1 attachment filename is header-safe and recovers for sanitize”. Its `expect(() => new Headers(...)).not.toThrow()` failed under the fault with the ByteString/ISO-8859-1 TypeError.

- Baseline: 3 passed.
- Fault: 1 failed (named test), 2 passed.
- Restored: 3 passed; scratch worktree removed.

**Next proof action:** retain the maintained Headers-safety assertion in default proof.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: `a58fe69dc24481f4e57459bf08c441a0dffd09e0`. Caught omission of header encoding. No follow-up story. Retain the assertion.
